prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 3.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1477
Claimant:
Melanie Chang
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
03/08/2025
First notice of loss received from the policyholder reporting a low-speed collision while the insured vehicle was parked
and stationary in a supermarket lot. The claimant, who was in the vehicle at the time, has retained counsel, and all
contact will go through the attorney's office.
03/12/2025
Assigned the file and requested the police report, which has been received and records the claimant as an occupant
of the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer's account matches the reported location and the general sequence
of events.
06/11/2025
Spoke with the policyholder, who confirmed the driver lives in the household and is listed as a covreed household
member under the policy. The policyholder had no knowledge of any prior damage to the vehicle.
07/01/2025
Reviewed the photographs submitted by the driver, which show damage to the rear bumper and tailgate consistent
with a rear impact. Some details in the photos line up with the reported account, though no independent witnesses
have come forward.
07/25/2025
Obtained a repair estimate from the authorized body shop. The damage is largely in line with the described impact,
and the shop found no sign of older repair work or pre-existing deterioration in the affected panels.
08/18/2025
Checked the vehicle history and prior claims records. No earlier damage to the vehicle appears in any source, and
nothing suggests the damage predates the policy inception date.
08/23/2025
Received the claimant's medical records through counsel. A concussion diagnosis was documented after the
incident, and the injury appears consistent with the kind and force of a collision of this type.
09/09/2025
Reviewed the medical history with the claimant's authorization. No earlier injury to the same body area is recorded,
and no prior treatment for head or neck complaints is known.
09/24/2025
Treatment followed a usual course, with initial evaluation, follow-up visits, and gradual reduction in care as symptoms
improved. The treating provider's notes describe steady recovery over the period.
10/07/2025
Spoke with counsel about the claimant's account. The claimant has described the events the same way in every
conversation so far, and the details have not shifted between the initial report and later interviews.
10/13/2025
Reviewed the file with the claims supervisor. The poilce record, the vehicle damage, and the medical findings are
consistent with one another, and no additional investigation appears necessary at this stage.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
